reason: The web address of a file's folder, https://disk.yandex.ru/client/disk/<path>, that each answer and the synced copy carry as url (src/yandex/source.ts); a person opens it, ydisk never sends a request there.

A live listing of one Disk folder: Yandex's GET /v1/disk/resources takes only path, sort, limit and offset (https://yandex.ru/dev/disk-api/doc/en/reference/meta), so there is nothing to filter by; search covers the synced copy.

A mirror is a saved pairing of a local folder and a Disk folder that mirrors sync keeps the same both ways, as drive's mirrors; no shared noun names it yet. ydisk is the second CLI on cli-core's mirrors, so mirrors belongs in the cli-base vocabulary.
The local versions cli-core's file mirror keeps of what a sync replaced or deleted (fileVersions); no shared noun names them yet.
Picks which side wins where a file changed both locally and on the Disk (local, disk or both), as drive's mirrors sync --keep; no shared flag names a conflict side yet.
The number of deletions the owner allows when cli-core's mirror guard stops a run (mirror.too-many-deletions); owner-only, kept off MCP.
The owner confirms that a replaced Disk or local folder is the mirror's folder now (cli-core's repin); owner-only, kept off MCP.
The profile's few saved folder pairs, read from one local file; nothing to filter by.
The events of one file of one mirror, already named by its arguments; nothing more to filter by.
The same choice as mirrors sync --keep, so the preview shows what that sync would do.
